newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket slips $0.06 to $20.80 in wk.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket slips $0.06 to $20.80 in wk.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of crude and products slipped $0.06 to $20.80 Friday from $20.86 Nov 15, Energy and Mines Ministry said.
The average price for the year so far is $17.79 per barrel, according to the ministry statement.
Venezuela's oil export price averaged $14.84 a barrel last year compared to $13.23 per barrel in 1994.
Venezuela's government has based its recently revised 1996 budget calculations on an average price of $17.00 per barrel.
